fusions.name: Palmed Blade
fusions.desc: Throws a blade that deals 5 damage. It has 50% more critical chance until something has bled.

fusions.name: Filleting Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps your blade through a cone 2.5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Hidden Edge
fusions.desc: Conjures a hidden trap of jaws onto the nearest enemy. It waits 30 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 20 damage in a blast around it. Its effect increases by 11% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Opened Seam
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, your next strike has 15% more critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.
